product_metadata.title: DECOMOMO Storage Bins | Fabric Storage Basket for Shelves for Organizing Closet Shelf Nursery Toy | Decorative Linen Closet Organizers with Handles Cubes (Navy Blue and White, Extra Large - 3 Pack)
features: Personalize Your Space - DECOMOMO's decorative basket comes in a variety of patterns and colors. Have your personality on display with our decorative storage baskets. Find the right pattern for you! Fun patterns makes for a ideal cute basket & decorative bins as gifts for friends, family, kids, baby, and more.

Unique Premium Design – Our bins are made stronger and more stable with a sewn-in MDF baseboard, thicken EVA fabric, upper metal frame, and durable faux leather handles. Carry your storage bins with ease knowing we added premium materials across the bin to keep them upright, balanced, and sturdy while still maintaining the soft-touch feel, and collapsible feature.

Space-Saving & Easy Storage: Set of 3 for better value and shopping convenience. The foldable feature allows you to save space when not in use and provides the convenience to bring along with you anywhere. Dimensions (each): 15.8” (L) x 12.5” (W) x 10” (H) / (40cm x 32 cm x 25 cm). This large size allowing to store a variety of items. Fits well with a variety of storage compartments and shelves.

Versatile Storage Baskets: DECOMOMO sturdy large bins provide a solution to many storage needs: organizing and storing baby products, clothes, shoes, kid’s toys, pet products, toiletry storage, laundry clothes, towel, blanket, bedsheet, sport gears, many other uses. DECOMOMO storage bins can be used in bedroom, living room, study room, rest room, kitchen, office, closets and cabinets. Its huge capacity makes it an excellent choice for keeping your space nice, tidy and organized.

Care tip: Baskets will be delivered folded. To get the wrinkles out the fabric storage bin, either stuff the fabric storage bins with blankets and pillows for a few days or steam iron them at low-heat setting.

details.Material: Cotton fabric, EVA, Polyester, Faux leather
